items.title: Beyond Code Snippets: Benchmarking LLMs on Repository-Level Question Answering
items.title_zh: 超越代码片段：在仓库级问答上评测 LLM
items.summary: StackRepoQA is described as the first multi-project, repository-level question answering dataset, built from 1,318 real developer questions and accepted answers across 134 open-source Java projects. Evaluating Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o under direct and agentic prompting, the authors find structural signals help but accuracy remains limited, and high scores often reflect verbatim reproduction of Stack Overflow answers rather than reasoning.

items.title: EviSearch: Trustworthy Extraction and Synthesis of Clinical Trial Evidence with Agents that Improve with Use
items.title_zh: EviSearch：用可随使用改进的 Agent 可信地提取与综合临床试验证据
items.summary: EviSearch is a multi-agent system that extracts evidence tables from clinical trial publications and admits a value only after an attribution verifier confirms it on the cited page. Running offline on open-weight models, it reached 91.70% accuracy autonomously and 95.22% after human review of 15.6% of cells on a clinician-annotated benchmark.

items.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Reinforced Self-Check for LLM Hallucination
items.title_zh: MARCH：面向 LLM 幻觉的多智能体强化自检框架
items.summary: MARCH orchestrates a Solver, a Proposer and a Checker, with the Checker validating claim-level propositions against retrieved evidence in isolation from the Solver's original output to break confirmation bias. Trained with multi-agent reinforcement learning, an 8B-parameter model using MARCH is reported as competitive with powerful closed-source models on hallucination benchmarks.

items.title: Show HN: Gemini can now natively embed video, so I built sub-second video search
items.title_zh: Show HN：Gemini 已能原生嵌入视频，我借此实现了亚秒级视频搜索
items.summary: The author built a CLI that uses Gemini Embedding 2 to project raw video into a 768-dimensional vector space alongside text, indexing hours of footage in ChromaDB for natural-language search with automatic clip trimming. Indexing costs about $2.50 per hour of footage, and still-frame detection skips idle chunks.

items.title: The Root Theorem of Context Engineering
items.title_zh: 上下文工程的根定理
items.summary: The paper derives a context-engineering principle from two axioms, finite context windows and quality degradation with accumulated volume: maximize signal-to-token ratio within bounded, lossy channels. It argues that append-only systems eventually exceed their effective window, that retrieval-augmented generation solves search but not continuity, and reports a 60+-session persistent architecture with a stable memory footprint.

items.title: Bridging the Know-Act Gap via Task-Level Autoregressive Reasoning
items.title_zh: 通过任务级自回归推理弥合知与行的差距
items.summary: Using FaultyScience, a new cross-disciplinary benchmark of faulty scientific questions, the authors show LLMs can identify flawed inputs under discriminative prompting but fail to act on that knowledge when generating answers. Their DeIllusionLLM framework models the validate-or-answer decision explicitly and uses self-distillation to reduce answer-despite-error failures.

items.title: Lie to Me: How Faithful Is Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Reasoning Models?
items.title_zh: 《Lie to Me》：推理模型的思维链有多忠实？
items.summary: The study tests 12 open-weight reasoning models (7B-685B) on 498 MMLU and GPQA Diamond questions with six categories of injected hints across 41,832 runs. Faithfulness ranged from 39.7% to 89.9%; models acknowledged hint influence in thinking tokens about 87.5% of the time but in answer text only about 28.6%.

items.title: STRIATUM-CTF: A Protocol-Driven Agentic Framework for Autonomous CTF Solving
items.title_zh: STRIATUM-CTF：面向自主 CTF 解题的协议驱动智能体框架
items.summary: STRIATUM-CTF is a modular CTF-solving framework that mediates between LLM reasoning and offensive-security tools using MCP, exposing tools as typed, schema-validated functions. In 180 controlled runs it succeeded on 77.8-86.7% of attempts, and it placed first in a single live, non-replicated multi-team CTF at Florida State University against more than 30 registered teams.

items.title: ReqFusion: A Multi-Provider Framework for Automated PEGS Analysis Across Software Domains
items.title_zh: ReqFusion：跨软件领域的多提供商 PEGS 自动化分析框架
items.summary: ReqFusion is a multi-provider framework that extracts and classifies software requirements from PDF, DOCX and PPTX documents using OpenAI, Anthropic and Groq models, guided by the PEGS structure. PEGS-guided prompting reached an F1 of 0.88 versus 0.71 for generic prompting, and evaluation on five projects with 1,050 requirements reported a 78% reduction in analysis time.

items.title: AVO: Agentic Variation Operators for Autonomous Evolutionary Search
items.title_zh: AVO：自主进化搜索的智能体变异算子
items.summary: Agentic Variation Operators replace fixed mutation and crossover heuristics with a self-directed coding-agent loop that consults lineage, a domain knowledge base and execution feedback to propose, repair and verify edits. Over seven days of autonomous evolution on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, AVO discovered attention kernels outperforming cuDNN by up to 3.5% and FlashAttention-4 by up to 10.5%.

items.title: LensWalk: Agentic Video Understanding by Planning How You See in Videos
items.title_zh: LensWalk：通过规划观看方式实现智能体式视频理解
items.summary: LensWalk is an agentic framework that lets an LLM reasoner control its own visual observation of video, specifying the temporal scope and sampling density at each step in a reason-plan-observe loop. Without model fine-tuning it boosts accuracy by over 5% on long-video benchmarks including LVBench and Video-MME.

items.title: Can Small Models Reason About Legal Documents? A Comparative Study
items.title_zh: 小模型能推理法律文书吗？一项比较研究
items.summary: The study tests nine sub-10B models across ContractNLI, CaseHOLD and ECtHR with five prompting strategies, running 405 experiments. A mixture-of-experts model activating 3B parameters matched GPT-4o-mini in mean accuracy, while chain-of-thought helped contract entailment but hurt multiple-choice legal reasoning and BM25 and dense RAG gave near-identical results.

items.title: No Hard Negatives Required: Concept Centric Learning Leads to Compositionality without Degrading Zero-shot Capabilities of Contrastive Models
items.title_zh: 无需难负样本：以概念为中心的学习在不损害零样本能力的前提下实现组合性
items.summary: The authors attribute weak compositionality in contrastive vision-language models to long training captions and global pooling, and propose short concept-centric caption parts plus parameter-free cross-modal attention pooling. The changes reach state-of-the-art compositionality results while maintaining or improving zero-shot and retrieval performance without extra inference cost.

items.title: ASTER -- Agentic Science Toolkit for Exoplanet Research
items.title_zh: ASTER：面向系外行星研究的智能体科学工具包
items.summary: ASTER is an orchestration framework that gives LLM agents domain-specific tools for exoplanet research, including NASA Exoplanet Archive queries, TauREx forward spectra and Bayesian retrievals, plus workflow planning and interpretation support. A case study on WASP-39b shows the agent moving between datasets, generating model spectra and performing retrievals.

items.title: Generalizable Foundation Models for Calorimetry via Mixtures-of-Experts and Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning
items.title_zh: 基于专家混合与参数高效微调的通用量热学基础模型
items.summary: The work builds a next-token transformer foundation model for calorimetry that combines mixture-of-experts pretraining with parameter-efficient fine-tuning, adding lightweight expert modules for new absorber materials and tuning for new particle types without catastrophic forgetting. It reports that next-token calorimeter models are computationally competitive with standard generative approaches under established LLM optimization procedures.

items.title: Development and Preliminary Evaluation of a Domain-Specific Large Language Model for Tuberculosis Care in South Africa
items.title_zh: 南非结核病护理领域专用大模型：开发与初步评估
items.summary: The study fine-tunes BioMistral-7B with QLoRA on South African TB guidelines, selected literature and medical benchmark data, and adds GraphRAG retrieval. Compared with the base model and a general-purpose LLM, the resulting domain-specific model shows better lexical, semantic and knowledge alignment for TB care.

items.title: PubMed Reasoner: Dynamic Reasoning-based Retrieval for Evidence-Grounded Biomedical Question Answering
items.title_zh: PubMed Reasoner：面向循证生物医学问答的动态推理检索
items.summary: PubMed Reasoner is a three-stage biomedical QA agent that refines MeSH queries using partial metadata, retrieves articles in batches until evidence is sufficient, and generates answers with explicit citations. With a GPT-4o backbone it reaches 78.32% accuracy on PubMedQA, slightly above human experts, and shows consistent gains on MMLU Clinical Knowledge.

items.title: Improving Clinical Diagnosis with Counterfactual Multi-Agent Reasoning
items.title_zh: 反事实多智能体推理改进临床诊断
items.summary: The framework applies counterfactual case editing to clinical findings and measures confidence shifts, termed the Counterfactual Probability Gap, to quantify how strongly each finding supports a diagnosis. These signals guide multi-round specialist-agent discussions, improving diagnostic accuracy over prompting and prior multi-agent baselines across three benchmarks and seven LLMs, with the largest gains on complex and ambiguous cases.

items.title: Graph-Aware Late Chunking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Biomedical Literature
items.title_zh: 面向生物医学文献检索增强生成的图感知后分块
items.summary: GraLC-RAG combines late chunking with structure-aware chunk boundaries, UMLS knowledge-graph infusion and graph-guided hybrid retrieval. On 2,359 PubMed Central articles, structure-aware methods retrieved from up to 15.6x more sections than content-similarity baselines, and KG infusion narrowed the answer-quality gap to a delta-F1 of 0.009.

items.title: Revisiting Quantum Code Generation: Where Should Domain Knowledge Live?
items.title_zh: 重新审视量子代码生成：领域知识应该放在哪里？
items.summary: The study compares a parameter-specialized Qiskit model against general-purpose LLMs augmented with RAG and execution-feedback agents on Qiskit-HumanEval. Fine-tuning reached about 47% pass@1, recent general models reached 60-65% zero-shot or with retrieval, and the strongest model reached up to 85% with iterative execution feedback.

items.title: SpecEyes: Accelerating Agentic Multimodal LLMs via Speculative Perception and Planning
items.title_zh: SpecEyes：通过推测式感知与规划加速智能体式多模态 LLM
items.summary: SpecEyes is a speculative acceleration framework for agentic multimodal LLMs that uses a lightweight, tool-free model as a planner to predict execution trajectories and terminate expensive tool chains early. A cognitive gating mechanism based on answer separability regulates self-verification, and experiments on V* Bench, HR-Bench and POPE show 1.1-3.35x speedup while preserving or improving accuracy by up to 6.7%.

items.title: Context-Mediated Domain Adaptation in Multi-Agent Sensemaking Systems
items.title_zh: 多智能体意义建构系统中的上下文中介领域自适应
items.summary: The authors propose context-mediated domain adaptation, in which user edits to system-generated artifacts act as implicit domain specifications that reshape multi-agent LLM reasoning. Their Seedentia system creates bidirectional semantic links between artifacts and reasoning; an expert evaluation extracted 46 domain knowledge entries from user modifications, though the small sample limits conclusions about systematic quality gains.

items.title: MemoryCD: Benchmarking Long-Context User Memory of LLM Agents for Lifelong Cross-Domain Personalization
items.title_zh: MemoryCD：面向终身跨域个性化的 LLM Agent 长上下文用户记忆基准
items.summary: MemoryCD is described as the first large-scale, user-centric, cross-domain memory benchmark, built from lifelong real-world behaviors in the Amazon Review dataset. It evaluates 14 LLM base models and 6 memory methods on 4 personalization tasks across 12 domains and finds existing memory methods fall short of user satisfaction.

items.title: From Actions to Understanding: Conformal Interpretability of Temporal Concepts in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 从行动到理解：LLM 智能体时序概念的一致性可解释性
items.summary: The paper introduces a conformal interpretability framework that combines step-wise reward modeling with conformal prediction to label an LLM agent's internal representations as successful or failing at each step. Linear probes on ScienceWorld and AlfWorld show the temporal concepts are linearly separable, and preliminary results suggest steering along successful directions can improve performance.

items.title: A Reference Architecture for Agentic Hybrid Retrieval in Dataset Search
items.title_zh: 面向数据集搜索的智能体混合检索参考架构
items.summary: The paper treats dataset search as a software-architecture problem and proposes a bounded, auditable architecture that fuses BM25 and dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion under an LLM agent that plans queries, judges result sufficiency and reranks candidates. It also has an LLM generate pseudo-queries offline to augment both indexes, and defines a seven-variant evaluation framework comparing a single ReAct agent with a multi-agent design.

items.title: ATLAS-RTC: Closing the Loop on LLM Agent Output with Token-Level Runtime Control
items.title_zh: ATLAS-RTC：用 token 级运行时控制为 LLM 智能体输出闭环
items.summary: ATLAS-RTC monitors autoregressive generation step by step, detects drift from output contracts and applies biasing, masking or rollback before errors materialize. It reports 20 to 37.8 percentage-point gains in first-attempt success on structured generation and tool-calling tasks, and up to 88% lower latency when failures dominate.

items.title: TailNLG: A Multilingual Benchmark Addressing Verbalization of Long-Tail Entities
items.title_zh: TailNLG：面向长尾实体表述的多语言基准
items.summary: TailNLG is a multilingual Data-to-Text benchmark built from Wikidata in English, Italian and Spanish that varies entity popularity. Evaluating three LLM families zero-shot, the authors find a consistent bias against long-tail entities, with lower embedding-based scores and higher model uncertainty for rare entities, which existing metrics do not reliably capture.

items.title: Mininglamp-AI/Mano-P
items.title_zh: Mininglamp-AI/Mano-P：面向边缘设备的开源 GUI-VLA 智能体
items.summary: Mano-P is an open-source GUI-VLA agent for edge devices that runs locally on Apple M4 Mac mini and MacBook hardware, keeps data on the device, and ranks first on the specialized OSWorld track at 58.2%.

items.title: larksuite/cli
items.title_zh: larksuite/cli：飞书官方命令行工具
items.summary: The official Lark/Feishu CLI, maintained by the larksuite team, is built for humans and AI agents and covers Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks and Meetings through more than 200 commands and 20+ agent skills.

items.title: Mangi-11/Eta
items.title_zh: Mangi-11/Eta：可直接访问 Android 系统底层的 AI 智能体
items.summary: Eta is a Kotlin system-level Android AI agent with direct OS access that steps outside the sandbox, letting models reach low-level APIs, the screen, the terminal and user data.

items.title: AstraAI: LLMs, Retrieval, and AST-Guided Assistance for HPC Codebases
items.title_zh: AstraAI：面向 HPC 代码库的 LLM、检索与 AST 辅助工具
items.summary: AstraAI is a command-line coding framework for HPC software development that combines LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation and AST-based structural analysis. It supports locally hosted Hugging Face models and API-based frontier models and is demonstrated on AMReX.

items.title: compozy/compozy
items.title_zh: Compozy：面向 AI 智能体的操作系统
items.summary: Compozy is a Go project described as an operating system for AI agents; it plugs in existing agent CLIs such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor so they can split work, share project memory and be steered from the browser.

items.title: ai-boost/awesome-harness-engineering
items.title_zh: awesome-harness-engineering：AI 智能体 harness 工程资源清单
items.summary: The repository is a curated list of resources for AI agent harness engineering, spanning tooling, design patterns, evaluations, memory, MCP, permissions, observability and orchestration.

items.title: graykode/abtop
items.title_zh: abtop：给 AI 编程智能体用的 htop
items.summary: abtop is a Rust tool modeled on htop that monitors AI coding agent sessions such as Claude Code and Codex CLI, tracking tokens, context-window use, rate limits and ports in real time.

items.title: Show HN: Gemini can now natively embed video, so I built sub-second video search
items.title_zh: Show HN：Gemini 已能原生嵌入视频，我借此实现了亚秒级视频搜索
items.summary: The author built a CLI that uses Gemini Embedding 2 to project raw video into a 768-dimensional vector space alongside text, indexing hours of footage in ChromaDB for natural-language search with automatic clip trimming. Indexing costs about $2.50 per hour of footage, and still-frame detection skips idle chunks.

items.title: Autoresearch on an old research idea
items.title_zh: 用 Autoresearch 推进一个旧研究想法
items.summary: A blogger applied Karpathy's Autoresearch, a constrained optimization loop built around an LLM agent, to old eCLIP research code via Claude Code. The agent iteratively edits train.py to improve an evaluation metric while following instructions in program.md, using a scratchpad file as working memory.

items.title: Show HN: Cq – Stack Overflow for AI coding agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：Cq——面向 AI 编程 Agent 的 Stack Overflow
items.summary: A Mozilla.ai staff engineer presents Cq, a proof-of-concept standard for shared agent learning in which agents propose schema-based knowledge units about gotchas they encounter and query existing ones, with human-in-the-loop review at the team level.

items.title: From zero to a RAG system: successes and failures
items.title_zh: 从零搭建 RAG 系统：成功与失败
items.summary: A blog post recounts the successes and failures the author encountered while building a retrieval-augmented generation system from scratch.

items.title: Helping developers build safer AI experiences for teens
items.title_zh: 帮助开发者打造更安全的青少年 AI 体验
items.summary: OpenAI released prompt-based teen safety policies for developers using gpt-oss-safeguard, intended to help moderate age-specific risks in AI systems.

items.title: The revenge of the data scientist
items.title_zh: 数据科学家的复仇
items.summary: The post discusses common AI evaluation mistakes and the data science practices that can fix them.

items.title: STADLER reshapes knowledge work at a 230-year-old company
items.title_zh: STADLER：用 ChatGPT 重塑一家 230 年历史企业的知识工作
items.summary: OpenAI published a customer story describing how STADLER uses ChatGPT to transform knowledge work, with reported time savings and productivity gains across 650 employees.
